title: Semantic Marketing Consolidation & Dashboard2 Legacy Residue Purge
spec:
CONSOLIDATION OBJECTIVE:
Eliminate architectural confusion surrounding 'Dashboard2' by establishing a clean, semantic marketing directory ('src/components/Marketing/') for all public landing elements, removing misleading legacy names while maintaining 100% backward-compatibility for existing routes, tests, and consumers.

ACTIONABLE EXECUTION PLAN:
1. Create semantic home:
   - Establish 'src/components/Marketing/' with 'elements/' containing 'HomepageNavbar.jsx', 'HomepageFooter.jsx', 'HomepageHero.jsx', 'HomepagePricing.jsx', 'Homepagefaqs.jsx', 'HomepageComparison.jsx', 'HomepageStorySections.jsx', etc.
   - Relocate 'src/components/Dashboard2/dashboard2.jsx' to 'src/components/Marketing/LandingPage.jsx'.
2. Backward-Compatible Facade:
   - Retain 'src/components/Dashboard2/' as re-export facades pointing to 'src/components/Marketing/' so any external or cached consumer continues to resolve without errors.
3. Migrate 15 Consumers:
   - Update all public page imports ('Plans.jsx', 'Features.jsx', 'BlogList.jsx', 'BlogPost.jsx', 'Contact.jsx', 'CustomePage.jsx', 'JobsLanding.jsx', 'MainJobListings.jsx', 'PortfolioBuilder.jsx', 'BlogEditor.jsx') to import cleanly from the semantic marketing directory.
4. Preserve Test Assertions:
   - Update test paths in 'tests/four-portal-architecture.test.mjs', 'tests/unlayered-css-guard.test.mjs', 'tests/product-ux-audit-regressions.test.mjs', 'tests/public-discovery.test.mjs', and 'tests/admin-workflow.test.mjs'.
   - Ensure 'Dashboard2Redirect' in 'src/main.jsx' remains intact for session-safe redirection from '/dashboard2' to '/dashboard'.
5. Verification Gate:
   - Zero build errors ('npm run build').
   - Zero broken routes (verify with Playwright crawler).
   - 100% passing test suites.
invariants: Resume Templates & ATS Engine 100% FROZEN (git diff = 0)
Zero broken public routes or dead navigation targets
acceptanceCriteria: Semantic Marketing directory created with all 14 landing elements
All 15 consumer components migrated to semantic marketing imports
npm run build succeeds in <4s with zero errors
